content.title: Nallur toll plaza on Kolkata National Highway to be moved to Durainallur
content.caption: The National Highways Authority of India plans to relocate the toll plaza at Nallur on the Chennai - Kolkata National Highway to Durainallur.

slides.heading: Nallur toll plaza relocation
slides.text: The National Highways Authority of India plans to relocate the toll plaza at Nallur on the Chennai - Kolkata National Highway to Durainallur.

slides.heading: Current situation
slides.text: The current toll plaza at Nallur is notorious for long waits during rush hours.
slides.image_search_query: Nallur toll plaza current situation India

slides.heading: Reasons for relocation
slides.text: Residents and businesses in the area have requested the relocation due to long waits and congestion.

slides.heading: Impact on users
slides.text: The relocation is expected to provide relief for motorists and reduce congestion.
